content: High CPU usage by unknown processes often indicates malware or crypto miners. Recommended action is to suspend the process and ask the user.
If VRAM is full and a high-priority image generation task arrives, the system should hibernate the LLM service to free up resources.
Ollama service requires approximately 6GB VRAM for Llama3-8b. Do not attempt to load if available VRAM is below this threshold.
